scenes.say: Imagine this. You live in California, where power costs about thirty cents a kilowatt-hour.
Solar should be a no-brainer, right?
Then came NEM three point oh.
Under NEM three, exported solar earns roughly a quarter of the retail rate on average.
So solar-only systems now pay back in about nine years, instead of five.
Adding a battery roughly doubles how much of your own solar you use, and usually increases twenty-five year savings.

lines: Solar alone or with a battery?
scenes.say: Not sure which is right for you? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
